title: 无重复字符的最长子串
statement: 给定一个 ASCII 字符串，返回不含重复字符的连续子串的最大长度。空串返回 0。
constraints: 0 ≤ 字符串长度 ≤ 100000；字符为 ASCII 可打印字符（含空格）

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：一整行字符串，允许空行和空格。stdout：一个整数。

en.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
en.statement: Given an ASCII string, return the length of the longest contiguous substring without repeating characters. An empty string returns 0.
constraints: 0 ≤ string length ≤ 100000; characters are printable ASCII (including space)

complexity.space: O(min(n, |Σ|)); O(1) for a fixed ASCII alphabet
complexity.notes: n is the string length and Σ the alphabet. The length limit follows the official problem; characters use the printable ASCII subset. A sliding window avoids rescanning.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: one whole line, which may be empty or contain spaces. stdout: one integer.

complexity.space: O(min(n, |Σ|))；固定 ASCII 字符集时 O(1)
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方公开题面列出字符串长度与字符范围，未明文指定 Big-O 上限。
complexity.notes: n 为字符串长度，Σ 为字符集。长度上限参考官方题面，字符采 ASCII 可打印子集。采滑动窗口避免重复扫描。
